properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile-declared dependency: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-1/SHA-2 family in JS), pinned in package-lock.json:3328 and pulled in as "hash.js": "^1.0.0" by elliptic@6.4.1 (package-lock.json:1589), itself a transitive dep of the composer-* devDependency chain. No first-party call site in the repo's own code (lib/, test/ have no crypto requires) — it ships with `npm install` when the composer SDKs are built. Changeable here by bumping the composer packages.

properties.name: pqs:context

No first-party call site in the repo's own code; ships with the devDependency tree of the composer-* SDKs. Changeable here by upgrading/removing those SDKs.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (secretbox/box) capability of tweetnacl@0.14.5 (package-lock.json:6131). Quantum-safe symmetric AE — kept in the inventory as the strongest crypto the shipped tree contains, even though the repo's own code never calls it (devDependency chain of composer-*). Note: tweetnacl 0.14.5 is a 2017 release with no STHAM/AEGIS alternatives — but as an AE scheme this needs no PQ migration.
